subject: Inference economics variance matrix + proposed deal path
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Samuel Park <samuel@wellwise.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + quick discovery — token targets and econ asks

Hi Samuel — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and the ask items so we can run a concise unit-econ model before the deep-dive: 

1) High-level monthly usage: estimated monthly active users (MAU) and average sessions per MAU.
2) Typical prompt+completion token profile: mean tokens per session and 95th percentile.
3) Target budget range for inference (monthly); do you think $/month bands of <$10k, $10–50k, $50–150k, >$150k make sense?
4) Business priority: are you optimizing for strict CAC payback (<12 months) or product margin targets (gross margin >70%)?

Attached a short discovery deck and a blank worksheet we use for $/1M-token targets. If you can drop the two usage rows and a budget band, Marissa and I will prepare a unit-econ sensitivity matrix and a recommended target $/1M tokens and per-feature cost.

Proposed next step: 30-min econ deep-dive Fri or Mon — we can bring Karthik for procurement/quantization scenarios.

Attachments: WW-discovery-deck.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Samuel Park <samuel@wellwise.ai>

Subject: Re: Intro + quick discovery — token targets and econ asks

Dylan — appreciate the recap. Answers below (high level):

- MAU: 45k (pilot cohort 12k, expansion cohort planned over next 9 months)
- Sessions per MAU: avg 3.2 sessions/month
- Tokens/session: mean ~820 tokens (prompt + completion), 95th ~2,400 tokens
- Budget: for pilot we’re targeting $20k–$40k/month. If we hit success metrics, expansion budget could move to $80k+/month in Q1 next year.
- Business priority: CAC payback target is 9 months for pilot-paid customers; overall margin target is 65–70% once at scale.

I attached a quick usage export (anonymized) — should help with the per-feature mapping. Also: procurement requires a simple SOW and a standard SOC2 attestation copy (we can share procurement timeline next call).

Best,
Samuel
Samuel Park
VP Product, WellWise Health
Attachments: ww-usage-snapshot.csv

On Thu, Jul 19, 2028 at 11:03 AM, Samuel Park <samuel@wellwise.ai> wrote:
> Dylan — appreciate the recap. Answers below (high level):
> 
> - MAU: 45k (pilot cohort 12k, expansion cohort planned over next 9 months)
> - Sessions per MAU: avg 3.2 sessions/month
> - Tokens/session: mean ~820 tokens (prompt + completion), 95th ~2,400 tokens
> - Budget: for pilot we’re targeting $20k–$40k/month. If we hit success metrics, expansion budget could move to $80k+/month in Q1 next year.
> - Business priority: CAC payback target is 9 months for pilot-paid customers; overall margin target is 65–70% once at scale.

Samuel — thanks, this is exactly what we needed. I pulled together a quick unit-econ sensitivity that maps: (A) $/1M tokens at three recommended price bands, (B) per-feature incremental cost assuming 1–3 features per session, and (C) CAC payback scenarios given your ARPU assumptions. See notes below and attached workbook.

High-level recommendations (preliminary):
- Conservative $/1M tokens band (pilot): $600–$750 — designed to hit ~9–12 month CAC payback with feature conversion rates of 8–12%.
- Aggressive $/1M tokens band (expansion): $350–$500 — achievable with quantized model variants + prefix caching; targets ~65–70% gross margin assuming $80k+ monthly spend.
- Per-feature estimate: with your tokens/session we estimate ~$0.60–$1.25 per feature (depends on # of features/avg tokens allocated to each).

Open questions we’ll model on the call:
- Feature mix: how many features will be active per session (1, 2, or 3+) — shifts per-feature costs materially.
- Acceptable latency SLOs (p50/p95) — tighter SLOs reduce batching/quantization options.
- Procurement constraints: any contract language or billing cadence preferences that affect discounting/commit sizing.

Next steps: we updated the unit-econ worksheet (attached) and propose a 30–45 minute econ session to walk sensitivity bands and lock a target $/1M tokens for pilot procurement. Karthik will bring a quantization/latency tradeoff primer.

Attachments: redwood-unit-econ-worksheet.xlsx

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

2) For the call please have your product lead (if available) to confirm expected feature-mix per session. That will materially change the per-feature math.
3) We’ll prepare two scenarios in advance: (A) pilot-band pricing that meets ~9mo CAC payback, (B) expansion-band pricing with quantization + cache that targets 65–70% gross margin at $80k/mo+.
